title: RepoMesh AgentTeams Task Package v2 Candidate Files
description: The two JSON files helper `bundle` writes into candidate/ (and the platform copies verbatim into a review package's review/). Validate changes.json against $defs/changes and evidence.json against $defs/evidence. This is the minimal evidence set: the request id of CONTEXT.md's four-tuple is replaced by attempt_id, and base_sha / head_sha pin the exact commit the evidence is about.

head_sha.description: The single candidate commit; its parent is base_sha.

changed_files.description: `git diff --name-status base_sha head_sha`, one entry per path.

status.description: First letter of git's name-status code (A M D R C T U X B).

tree.description: git tree hash of the whole working tree at the last `test` run; `bundle` refuses when the tree changed since.

tests.description: One entry per frozen test command, in package.json order.

exit_code.description: The command's exit status; 124 when the helper's timeout fired.
